_note: Bridge HTTP errors use machine codes. Decision validation currently returns user-facing messages and always rejects; request/answer labels below are descriptive, not a completed submission protocol.
content_type_required: An exact application/json MIME type is required
object_required: JSON root must be an object
unknown_event: Hook event is outside the supported observation whitelist
nonce_capacity: Live nonce limit reached; reject without evicting replay protection
unauthorized: Token, plugin instance or protocol header did not match the active bridge
nonce_required: The request did not contain a nonce
timestamp_required: The request did not contain a current sent-at timestamp
stale_request: The request timestamp is outside the bridge clock-skew window
replayed_nonce: The nonce was already accepted by this bridge instance
body_too_large: The hook JSON exceeded the 256 KiB bridge limit
invalid_json: The hook input was not one JSON document
route_mismatch: The event was sent to the wrong read-only or interaction bridge route
inbox_unavailable: The read-only event inbox could not be written
protocol_not_frozen: Approval, question and plan decisions are disabled until real fixtures are reviewed
request_key_invalid: The internal CodeCraft request key is invalid or does not belong to the session
answer_invalid: Only structural JSON/length checks exist; no successful answer submission or saved-schema validation is claimed
plan_feedback_required: A rejected plan must include bounded feedback
